stem: Which of the following best describes a multinational corporation (MNC)?
options: A company that owns or controls production in more than one nation
A company that only sells its finished goods in more than one nation
A company that is owned by the governments of more than one nation
A company that imports its raw materials from more than one nation
explanation: Correct option: (A). The chapter defines an MNC as a company that owns or controls production in more than one nation. Selling abroad or importing raw materials is foreign trade, which any company can do; MNCs are not defined by government ownership.
